activity_summary: At the Henley Street door Anne went ahead with the three children. Your father stayed behind the shut shop door. You gave your mother your arm. She said it was two years since she had had it.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Offered his mother his arm and left the shop door shut.

entities.name: Mary Shakespeare
entities.context: Took his arm at the threshold and named the two years.

entities.name: Judith Shakespeare
entities.context: Walked ahead with Anne, her cuff in Susanna's hand.

facets.activity: Gave Mother an arm at the Henley Street door

quotes.speaker: mary_shakespeare
quotes.text: Leave the shop door as it stands, Will.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Take my arm. It is two years since I walked you this way.

quotes.speaker: mary_shakespeare
quotes.text: It is two years since I had it.
